plain_definition: The detailed, form-by-form guidance HKMA gives Authorized Institutions (banks) on exactly how to fill in a specific regulatory return -- which figures go in which field, how to classify a given exposure, and so on. HKMA often consults the industry (via the Hong Kong Association of Banks or the Deposit-Taking Companies Association) on draft or revised completion instructions before a new or amended return takes effect.
formal_definition: Explanatory guidance issued by HKMA accompanying a banking return form (e.g. an 'MA(BS)' series return), setting out how Authorized Institutions must complete each field of that return; frequently abbreviated 'CI' or 'CIs' in HKMA consultation document titles.
